other_hydrophones.name: East Point, Saturna Island
other_hydrophones.note: Live stream on simres.ca when on air (often offline). Boundary Pass and the southern Strait of Georgia.

other_hydrophones.name: Monarch Head, Saturna Island
other_hydrophones.note: Second channel of the SIMRES stream. Inside the Saturna vessel-restricted zone.

other_hydrophones.name: Swanson Channel, North Pender Island
other_hydrophones.note: Hydrophone and camera livestream on Raincoast's YouTube channel, in a Southern Resident sanctuary zone.

other_hydrophones.name: OrcaLab, Hanson Island
other_hydrophones.note: A network of hydrophones in Blackfish Sound, Blackney Pass and Johnstone Strait, streamed live by OrcaLab (Northern Residents, Bigg's orcas, humpbacks).

other_hydrophones.name: Robson Bight (rubbing beach)
other_hydrophones.note: Underwater camera with hydrophone audio at times, in the Michael Bigg Ecological Reserve.

other_hydrophones.name: Boundary Pass listening station
other_hydrophones.note: Research station under the shipping lanes; detections go to a researcher portal, no public audio.

other_hydrophones.name: Strait of Georgia Central
other_hydrophones.note: Cabled seafloor hydrophone. Archived audio needs a free ONC account and token, so it isn't streamed here.

other_hydrophones.name: Strait of Georgia East
other_hydrophones.note: Cabled seafloor hydrophone. Needs a free ONC account and token.

other_hydrophones.name: Saanich Inlet, Patricia Bay
other_hydrophones.note: Cabled observatory node. Needs a free ONC account and token.

other_hydrophones.name: Folger Passage, Barkley Sound
other_hydrophones.note: West coast of Vancouver Island. Needs a free ONC account and token.

other_hydrophones.name: Clayoquot Slope
other_hydrophones.note: Offshore of the west coast of Vancouver Island. Needs a free ONC account and token.
